Name: Toro's Anime Sebastian Portraits
Author: SuicideToro
Description:
Hi, this is Toro! I made my own Sebastian portrait because I wanted him to be extra handsome lol. Maybe eventually I’ll make the other bachelors/bachelorettes, but for now you gotta put up with Seb looking different from the other villagers :P

In order to use it in your Stardew Valley game, please look at the following instructions:

You [b]MUST[/b] have the following mods installed:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]Platonymous Toolkit[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture mod[/url] 
Please look at the individual mod pages for instructions on how to install them.

Steps:
[list=1]
[*]Install the above three mods
[*]Download the zip from this mod
[*]Extract the folder into C:\Program Files\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits (or wherever you placed your Stardew Valley game mods folder) 
[*]Run the game with SMAPI and press P when talking to Sebastian until you change to the new Sebastian portrait
[*]Enjoy! 
[/list]
